# exo_email_tenant_settings (Data Source)

Look up an existing EmailTenantSettings object. Set identity to select it.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `identity` (String) Identity used to look up the object.

### Read-Only

- `enable_priority_account_protection` (Boolean) Maps to the -EnablePriorityAccountProtection parameter.
- `id` (String) Object identifier (GUID).
- `ignore_dehydrated_flag` (Boolean) Maps to the -IgnoreDehydratedFlag parameter.
